findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_url_status, expand_short_url, seo_audit, sitemap_urls, robots_txt_check · Private data: dns_lookup, domain_whois, sitemap_urls, generate_password · Public sink: check_url_status, link_preview · Destructive: validate_iban, synonyms, spell_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_url_status, expand_short_url, seo_audit, sitemap_urls, robots_txt_check · Private data: dns_lookup, domain_whois, sitemap_urls, generate_password · Public sink: check_url_status, link_preview · Destructive: validate_iban, synonyms, spell_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
